text.en: Handlers describe the facility as an exciting and stimulating space where dogs look forward to practicing agility and basic manners. Pet parents note that trainers understand varied temperaments and help active or stubborn pups build focus without frustration.

Reviewers praise instructors like Alex and Justin for their supportive guidance and patience during group and private sessions. While one client noted difficulties resolving package policies with management, the direct training staff is viewed favorably.

Clients report enjoyable and tangible progress through regular agility courses and one-on-one obedience lessons. Dog owners appreciate practical exercises to practice at home and notice increased confidence and responsiveness in their pets within weeks.

q.en: Do they offer beginner agility classes for dogs with no prior experience?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention that agility classes are beginner-friendly and provide fun, addictive exercises for dogs and owners starting from scratch.

q.en: Are one-on-one private lessons available alongside group classes?

a.en: Yes, clients note booking individual private sessions with trainers to address specific behavioral challenges like pulling on leash or jumping.

q.en: What should clients verify regarding training packages and expiration dates?

a.en: Reviewers recommend confirming class package expiration policies upon enrollment, as unused sessions may expire after a set timeframe.

q.en: Do trainers provide exercises to practice between classes?

a.en: Yes, owners report receiving fun homework drills and tailored routines to continue reinforcing training progress at home.
